records.label: spacr.mask_io#9
records.source: Every object is one feature, ROI or annotation, carrying its object type (``cell``, ``nucleus`` ...), its object id and its class; the class defaults to the object type. Each object is traced on its own, so objects that touch stay separate. Outlines follow PIXEL EDGES, not pixel centres: a pixel ``(row, col)`` is the square from ``x = col`` to ``col + 1`` and ``y = row`` to ``row + 1``, the convention QuPath and ImageJ both use. A pixel is inside a polygon when its centre is, so a traced outline rasterised back gives the object exactly: no tolerance, holes and several-part objects included. A hole is an interior ring (GeoJSON), a path of a composite ROI (ImageJ) or, since a COCO polygon cannot have one, an RLE segmentation (COCO).

records.source: ``binary_fill_holes`` over the whole foreground would also fill the gap BETWEEN objects that happen to ring a piece of background, so each label is filled on its own and written back only onto background: a hole never overwrites another object's pixels. records.source: The profiling helpers turn Measure's per-object tables into well and treatment profiles and score them, following pycytominer and copairs so the numbers agree with those tools on the same features. Each object table is aggregated to a per-well median, a plate map adds the treatment annotations, features are normalised plate by plate against the negative-control wells (robust MAD by default), uninformative and redundant features are removed (variance, frequency, correlation, missing values and outliers), and replicate wells are collapsed into consensus profiles. Replicate reproducibility is scored as mean average precision (mAP) with copairs' permutation null and Benjamini-Hochberg correction: phenotypic activity (replicates against controls) and, given a phenotype label, phenotypic consistency (treatments that share the label). Percent replicating is reported beside it. Profiles are written as CSV and Parquet with ``Metadata_`` columns, the consensus also as GCT, with an mAP plot and a consensus-similarity heatmap. Measure runs the whole recipe at the end of a run when ``profiling`` is on.
records.context: The profiling helpers turn Measure's per-object tables into well and treatment profiles and score them, following pycytominer and copairs so the numbers agree with those tools on the same features. Each object table is aggregated to a per-well median, a laboratory microplate map adds the treatment annotations, features are normalised laboratory microplate by laboratory microplate against the negative-control microplate sample positions (robust MAD by default), uninformative and redundant features are removed (variance, frequency, correlation, missing values and outliers), and replicate microplate sample positions are collapsed into consensus profiles. Replicate reproducibility is scored as mean average precision (mAP) with copairs' permutation null and Benjamini-Hochberg correction: phenotypic activity (replicates against controls) and, given a phenotype label, phenotypic consistency (treatments that share the label). Percent replicating is reported beside it. Profiles are written as CSV and Parquet with ``Metadata_`` columns, the consensus also as GCT, with an mAP plot and a consensus-similarity heatmap. Measure runs the whole recipe at the end of a run when ``profiling`` is on.
records.translation: प्रोफ़ाइलिंग सहायक Measure की प्रति-ऑब्जेक्ट तालिकाओं को वेल और उपचार प्रोफ़ाइल में बदलते हैं और उन्हें स्कोर करते हैं, pycytominer और copairs का अनुसरण करते हुए ताकि समान विशेषताओं पर संख्याएँ उन टूल से मेल खाएँ। हर ऑब्जेक्ट तालिका को प्रति-वेल माध्यिका में समेकित किया जाता है, प्लेट मैप उपचार एनोटेशन जोड़ता है, विशेषताओं को नकारात्मक-नियंत्रण वेल के विरुद्ध प्लेट-दर-प्लेट सामान्यीकृत किया जाता है (डिफ़ॉल्ट रूप से रोबस्ट MAD), कम जानकारी वाली और अनावश्यक विशेषताएँ हटाई जाती हैं (प्रसरण, आवृत्ति, सहसंबंध, लुप्त मान और बाहरी मान), और प्रतिकृति वेल को सहमति प्रोफ़ाइल में मिलाया जाता है। प्रतिकृति पुनरुत्पादकता को copairs के क्रमचय शून्य वितरण और Benjamini-Hochberg सुधार के साथ mean average precision (mAP) के रूप में स्कोर किया जाता है: फीनोटाइपिक गतिविधि (नियंत्रणों के विरुद्ध प्रतिकृतियाँ) और, फीनोटाइप लेबल दिए जाने पर, फीनोटाइपिक संगति (लेबल साझा करने वाले उपचार)। प्रतिशत प्रतिकृति उसके बगल में बताई जाती है। प्रोफ़ाइल ``Metadata_`` कॉलम के साथ CSV और Parquet के रूप में लिखी जाती हैं, सहमति GCT के रूप में भी, साथ में एक mAP प्लॉट और सहमति-समानता हीटमैप। जब ``profiling`` चालू हो, तब Measure प्रोसेसिंग के अंत में पूरी विधि चलाता है।
